name: Gabriel Lippmann
summary: French physicist and inventor of interference colour photography, Nobel laureate in Physics 1908.

name: Auguste Lumière
summary: French manufacturer and inventor who assisted Lippmann with photographic emulsions.

name: Louis Lumière
summary: French manufacturer and inventor who assisted Lippmann with photographic emulsions.

name: Sorbonne
summary: University in Paris where Lippmann was Professor of Mathematical Physics.

name: Bureau of Longitude
summary: French scientific institution of which Lippmann was a member.

name: Paris Académie des Sciences
summary: French scientific academy where Lippmann presented his 1891 paper.

name: Royal Society
summary: British scientific academy where Lippmann's spectra were displayed in 1891.

name: Nobel Prize in Physics 1908
summary: Physics Nobel Prize awarded to Lippmann for colour photography.

name: Lippmann photograph
summary: Colour photograph produced using interference method invented by Lippmann.

name: Lippmann emulsion
summary: Photographic emulsion receptive to recording interference, used in Lippmann photography.
